preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 1 and 30 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**9 and 0 <= y <= 10**9 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: Each point (x, y) must have coordinates between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of points named must be exactly n.
All named points must be distinct.
The line coordinates (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) must have coordinates between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) forming the line must not coincide.

postconditions.expression: all((y2 - y1) * (x - x1) != (y - y1) * (x2 - x1) for (x, y) in points)
postconditions.description: No point must lie on the line defined by (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).

postconditions.expression: all((y2 - y1) * (x - x1) < (y - y1) * (x2 - x1) for (x, y) in black_points) and all((y2 - y1) * (x - x1) > (y - y1) * (x2 - x1) for (x, y) in white_points)
postconditions.description: All black points must lie on one side of the line and all white points must lie on the other side of the line.
